description:
Twenty trials of StreamAC on masked Brax Hopper, to produce a best setting for a cross-implementation ablation rather than to win a score. What it is for: the rewritten kernel agrees with upstream's arithmetic block by block and with the recorded snapshot to a handful of last bits, but neither of those says the two behave alike over two million steps. So this searches, and then the point it lands on is run again on upstream's own implementation and the two curves are compared.
Six hyperparameters are searched and everything else is pinned to the settings the recorded 1043.66 run used, so the search is over the same slice that sweep searched. Twenty TPE trials over six dimensions is not a converged search and the best point here should not be read as a tuned one; it is a point both implementations can be asked about.
The seed is fixed. Two runs of the same setting under different seeds differ by more than the implementations are expected to, and a comparison that cannot separate the two would answer nothing.
Gradient and trace norms are reported per network part, which is the reading this run exists to collect beside the returns: under exact credit the torso sees the whole stream while what feeds it sees one step, and whether that pulls the two domains apart is the question the ablation after this one asks.
name: search-20
